notes.notes:
1. The new mini game "Brick Shatterer" in the lobby is online, combining classic brick playing techniques with VR tennis. Wave your racket and hit the ball at the bricks, smashing them all!
2. Optimization and update of the sub game "Star Realm": adding single/double mode; Add Endless Mode; Add additional rewards after killing elite monsters.
3. New Achievements: Virus Battle/Star Trek/Zuma/Iron Ring Maze/Fruit Adventure/Balloon Playing/Ferrules/Pets, etc.
4. Fix some known bugs and optimize some systems.
